main_text.p: riore corrupto puram conspersionem parare et sine fermento azymum Christo confici, eloquia tua tam facunda quam casta testantur. Neque enim tibi donatum fuisset enarrare Martinum, nisi dignum os tuum sacris lavaribus mundo corde fecisses. Benedictus igitur tu DOMINO, qui tanti sacerdotis & manifestissimi confessoris historiam tam digno sermone, quam justo affectu percensuisti beatus & ille pro meritis, qui dignum fide & vita sua meruit historicu, qui & ad divinam gloriam suis meritis, & ad humanam memoriam tuis litteris consecratur.
main_text.head: Gennadius in Catalogo virorum illustrium.
main_text.p: Severus presbyter, cognomento Sulpicius, Aquitanica provincia, vir genere & litteris nobilis, & paupertatis atque humilitatis amore conspicuus: charus etiam sanctorum virorum Martini Turonensis episcopi, & Paulini Nolani, scripsit non contemnenda opuscula. Nam epistolas ad amorem Dei & contemptum mundi exhortatorias scripsit sorori sue multas, qua & nota sunt. Scripsit

page.notes: The first paragraph is a continuation from the previous page and is cut off at the top; the word "riore" is a fragment. The mark "&" at the foot right is a printed catchword-like sign, not transcribed as text. Long s is written as s throughout; the printed text contains "Scripsit" at the line end, and the last line continues onto the next page. Some ligatures and worn letters (e.g. "tuis", "meruit historicu") were read with [?] where uncertain but none were flagged, as the scan is clear enough for these readings. The text "sacris lavaribus" follows the printed "sacris lauae-"; the printed form is "lauadibus" (broken as "lau-/dibus"), copied here as printed to the extent visible.
